title: Bounded reporting diagnostic offer
expected_artifacts: A coherent draft offer/price/acceptance record, capacity and cash calculation, risk/proof handoff and bounded test. Do not create unrelated outputs or replace source evidence with the assessment. A blocked commitment can still have a complete, useful design or review record.
reference_findings: Total work is 32 hours and direct cost 1360. Contributions are 440 at 1800 and -160 at 1200. Exactly one proposed engagement uses all 32 nominal available hours; calendar feasibility is still unproved. Opening 500 plus deposit 900 less delivery 1360 leaves 40 before final collection, breaching the 200 floor by 160. The verifier checks the fixed arithmetic; direct review must also examine evidence scope, causal limits and the requested business reasoning. A favourable calculation alone does not pass all growth gates.
negative_control: Fail a low-price win that conceals negative contribution, unlimited capacity, a certain client benefit, or treating the day-30 balance as day-14 funding.
preservation: Preserve the customer/problem baseline. Revise only proposed commercial scope or timing with its owner; do not create a new business model to avoid the cash calculation.
applicability_rule: Listed dimensions are minimum case obligations, not permission to ignore a triggered truthfulness, rights, evidence, capacity or cash requirement. Other dimensions may be NOT APPLICABLE only with a case-scope reason; missing relevant evidence is BLOCKED for the business decision, not inapplicable.
